rationale: Hurricane Polo intensifies to Category 5 off Mexico, driven by record El Niño; indirect climate pattern impact on Portugal's Atlantic weather and tourism season.

top_events.title: Hurricane Polo, rapidly intensifying from strong El Niño patterns, rages off coast of Mexico
top_events.label: Category 5 Hurricane Polo intensifies off Mexico
top_events.summary: Polo reaches sustained winds of 165mph, churning 215 miles south of Zihuatanejo. Driven by record El Niño patterns, unlikely to directly hit Mexico but signals intense Atlantic season.

top_events.title: Developing El Niño becomes strongest on record weeks before expected peak
top_events.label: Strongest El Niño on record impacts weather
top_events.summary: Scientists confirm developing El Niño is now strongest on record with global weather impacts already being felt, potentially affecting Iberian climate and wildfire risk.

top_events.title: Colombia declares public calamity as wildfire threatens popular tourist area
top_events.label: Colombia wildfire threatens Villa de Leyva area
top_events.summary: Wildfire forces evacuations and burns through mountains surrounding Villa de Leyva in north-east Colombia. Distant event with no direct impact on Portugal.

short_summary: El Niño becomes strongest on record globally

most_significant_event.label: El Niño becomes strongest on record globally
most_significant_event.summary: Strongest El Niño on record develops with global weather impacts already felt; potential indirect effects on Iberian Peninsula climate patterns, agriculture, and wildfire risk in coming months.
